claude.sample_unit: patient education materials (99 online web sites, 60 ChatGPT responses)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of patient education materials with vs without plain-language sixth-grade prompting
links.effect: Median FKGL 10.0 for standard ChatGPT vs 5.8 for simplified ChatGPT (p<0.001); simplified aligned with sixth-grade level (p=0.19); DISCERN quality did not differ (p=0.083).
links.quote: Pairwise testing showed that the median FKGL of simplified ChatGPT responses was significantly lower than that of OPEMs ( p < 0.001) and of standard ChatGPT responses ( p < 0.001), indicating an increased ease of readability in simplified ChatGPT responses ( Fig. 1 and Table 1 ).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient materials versus the sixth-grade recommended level, with and without simplification prompt
links.effect: OPEMs median FKGL 10.8 and standard ChatGPT 10.0 exceeded sixth grade (p<0.001); simplified ChatGPT 5.8 was at par (p=0.19).
links.quote: The median FKGL of simplified ChatGPT responses was at par with the NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendations ( p = 0.19), while the median FKGL of OPEMs and standard ChatGPT responses were both significantly greater than the NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendations ( p < 0.001; Fig. 1 ).

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT output quality across prompt variants differing in literacy level
links.effect: DISCERN quality did not differ between standard (56.2) and simplified (53.5) ChatGPT responses (p=0.083), though readability changed markedly; only content quality was assessed, not clinical safety consistency.
links.quote: There was no significant difference in median DISCERN score between the three patient education modalities ( p = 0.083).

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM to write at a sixth-grade level to improve readability of patient education materials

links.outcome: FKGL readability of patient education materials
links.effect: Simplified ChatGPT FKGL 5.8 (5.3–6.4) vs OPEMs 10.8 (9.4–12.8) and standard 10.0 (9.8–10.4); pairwise p<0.001.
links.quote: The median FKGL of simplified ChatGPT responses was at par with the NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendations ( p = 0.19), while the median FKGL of OPEMs and standard ChatGPT responses were both significantly greater than the NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendations ( p < 0.001; Fig. 1 ).

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials
links.effect: Median FKGL was 10.0 for standard ChatGPT (p<0.001 vs sixth-grade recommendation) and 5.8 for simplified ChatGPT (p=0.19), with DISCERN quality scores remaining comparable across modalities (p=0.083).
links.quote: The median FKGL of simplified ChatGPT responses was at par with the NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendations ( p = 0.19), while the median FKGL of OPEMs and standard ChatGPT responses were both significantly greater than the NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendations ( p < 0.001; Fig. 1 ).

unlisted_practices: Prompting generative AI to simplify text to a target reading level (e.g., sixth-grade level) for patient education materials
